title: This Is When IBM's CEO Says Quantum Computing Could Start to Have a "Measurable Impact" on Its Bottom Line
byline: David Jagielski, CPA, The Motley Fool
excerpt: Quantum computing is a huge growth opportunity for IBM, and in a few years the company may begin to reap significant benefits from it.
content_html:
Quantum computing has been an area of tech that growth investors have been targeting in recent years. In 2024, shares of Rigetti Computing soared more than 1,400%. While the enthusiasm has cooled of late given the long-term question marks and uncertainty around the business, quantum computing can have a significant and profound impact on the tech sector as a whole.

But rather than investing in a small, risky stock such as Rigetti, a safer option to consider may be a big behemoth such as International Business Machines (NYSE: IBM). It's investing heavily in quantum computing, and it anticipates it'll start having a noticeable impact on its business in the not-too-distant future.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Quantum computing is a huge opportunity for IBM

Quantum computers can solve complex problems significantly faster than current computers can. And with artificial intelligence creating a surge in demand for compute power, quantum computers may come online at a pivotal time for the tech sector.

IBM is a leading tech company that's been investing heavily in quantum computing, and its CEO Arvind Krishna believes that it won't be too much longer before investors start to see a payoff. "I think that in 2028 or 2029, you'll see it have a measurable impact on our top line and bottom line," Krishna forecasted in a recent interview on CNBC. He believes the growth opportunities in the space could be tremendous. "By the end of the 2030s, we are now pretty convinced this is a trillion dollars of value."

For IBM investors, it's welcome news after the stock's struggles this year. It has fallen 19% thus far in 2026, with the market being unimpressed with its growth and recent results. While quantum computing may not turn things around for IBM this year, there is hope that down the road it may be a game changer for the business.

Is IBM's stock a bargain buy right now?

When the market panics and overreacts, it can create some great buying opportunities for long-term investors. That may have happened when IBM's stock crashed a month ago after releasing preliminary numbers that were well short of expectations. While it has been rising since then, it's still down significantly this year.

Trading at a price-to-earnings multiple of 21, it's a reasonably priced stock given that the S&P 500 averages an earnings multiple of 26. IBM is still a top tech stock to own, and with tremendous long-term opportunities related to quantum computing, now, while its valuation remains low, could be an ideal time to buy it.

content_html_zh:
量子计算一直是成长型投资者近年来瞄准的一个科技领域。 2024年，RigettiComputing的股价飙升超过1400%。 尽管由于长期的问号和业务的不确定性，热情最近有所降温，但量子计算可以对整个科技行业产生重大而深远的影响。

但与其投资 Rigetti 这样的小型高风险股票，更安全的选择可能是国际商业机器公司（纽约证券交易所股票代码：IBM）这样的庞然大物。 该公司正在大力投资量子计算，预计在不久的将来它将开始对其业务产生显着影响。

错过了 2009 年的 Nvidia？ 这个罕见的信号再次闪烁。 2009年，一家名不见经传的芯片制造商英伟达发出了“双倍下跌”的信号。 多年来，对于一家规模仅为 Nvidia 1/100 的公司来说，同样的“完全确信”信号闪烁。 继续 ”

量子计算对 IBM 来说是一个巨大的机遇

量子计算机可以比当前计算机更快地解决复杂问题。 随着人工智能对计算能力的需求激增，量子计算机可能会在科技行业的关键时刻上线。

IBM 是一家领先的科技公司，一直在量子计算领域投入巨资，其首席执行官 Arvind Krishna 相信，用不了多久，投资者就会开始看到回报。 Krishna 在最近接受 CNBC 采访时预测：“我认为，到 2028 年或 2029 年，你会看到它对我们的营收和利润产生重大影响。” 他相信该领域的增长机会可能是巨大的。 “到 2030 年代末，我们现在非常确信这将达到一万亿美元的价值。”

对于 IBM 投资者来说，在该股今年表现不佳之后，这是一个好消息。 截至 2026 年，该数字已下跌 19%，市场对其增长和近期业绩不以为然。 虽然量子计算今年可能无法扭转 IBM 的局面，但人们希望它在未来可能会改变该业务的游戏规则。

IBM 的股票现在便宜吗？

当市场恐慌和反应过度时，可以为长期投资者创造一些绝佳的买入机会。 这种情况可能是在一个月前 IBM 公布的初步数据远低于预期后股价暴跌时发生的。 尽管此后一直在上升，但今年仍大幅下降。

考虑到标准普尔 500 指数的平均市盈率为 26 倍，该股的市盈率为 21 倍，是一只定价合理的股票。 IBM 仍然是值得拥有的顶级科技股，并且拥有与量子计算相关的巨大长期机会，尽管其估值仍然较低，但现在可能是购买它的理想时机。
